title.ko: 비즈니스 관용구: the bottom line · break even · cut corners · a golden opportunity · in the red
title.en: business and money idioms: the bottom line, break even, cut corners, a golden opportunity, in the red

explain.ko: 비즈니스 관용구는 돈과 사업을 비유적으로 말합니다. in the red는 적자, in the black은 흑자를 뜻합니다(회계 장부의 잉크 색에서 유래). break even은 본전, cut corners는 대충 하다, the bottom line은 최종 결산 또는 핵심을 뜻합니다. foot the bill, make a killing, tighten one's belt 같은 표현은 신문과 회의에서 흔합니다. 격식 있는 보고서에서는 관용구보다 정확한 용어를 쓰기도 합니다.
explain.en: Business idioms describe money and enterprise figuratively. In the red means making a loss, and in the black means making a profit (from the ink colours in ledgers). Break even means neither profit nor loss, cut corners means doing a job carelessly, and the bottom line means the final figure or the essence. Foot the bill, make a killing and tighten one's belt are common in newspapers and meetings. In formal reports, precise terms may replace idioms.

prompt.ko: 비즈니스 관용구를 사용해 한 회사의 재정 상황을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write four sentences about a company's finances using business idioms.

task.model: The company has been in the red for three years. This year it only just broke even by cutting costs. But cutting corners on safety to save money would be dangerous. The bottom line is to find new opportunities while preserving quality.

model_trans.ko: 그 회사는 3년째 적자를 내고 있어요. 올해는 비용을 줄여 간신히 본전을 건졌어요. 그러나 안전을 소홀히 하며 비용을 아낀다면 위험해요. 핵심은 품질을 지키면서 새로운 기회를 찾는 거예요.
model_trans.en: The company has been in the red for three years. This year it only just broke even by cutting costs. But cutting corners on safety to save money would be dangerous. The bottom line is to find new opportunities while preserving quality.
